universal_obligations.rule: Inventory every material source README unit and bind it to preserve, evidence-backed correction, explicit uncertainty, or omission; source bytes are valuable input but not factual approval.
Every material inherited or generated claim, command, example, limitation, and link must cite an accepted fact or authoritative disposition.
The visitor-facing README and generated code examples contain no HTML comments, ownership markers, agent annotations, code comments, or docstrings.
Start with one factual H1 and only fact-eligible package, version, download, and license badges; omit unsupported badges.
Explain the product and reader value before any aspose.org, aspose.com, or Enterprise Edition reference.
Render one parseable product-specific Mermaid flowchart whose bounded labels cite accepted identity, audience, problems, capabilities, formats, platforms, or acquisition facts.
Present only the accepted acquisition path and coordinates; source-build-only products must not acquire a registry-install claim or package badge.
Present one primary ecosystem-native minimal example backed by the accepted example fact and avoid competing primary examples.
Provide useful navigation to applicable usage, capabilities or formats, installation, contribution, license, security, support, and limitations content without inventing missing repository surfaces.

Select only live catalog links that directly help the adjacent claim or example, record a context binding, apply configured-or-automatic ceilings, prefer exact articles over generic product pages, and allow zero links.

Every visitor-facing aspose.com product reference uses the verified product name and exact descriptor Enterprise Edition; prohibited commercial, On-Premise, paid, full, proprietary, or premium edition names are correction inputs.
Do not create an opening promotion, standalone promotional block, repetitive calls to action, keyword stuffing, or link insertion merely to fill capacity.

Structure, terminology, installation, example, capabilities, formats, limitations, and relationship prose must be derived from this repository's accepted inputs rather than a universal product template.
Produce a source-hash-bound native Git patch; all content outside authorized operations remains byte-identical.
An identical accepted source, fact, policy, and prompt input must reproduce the same logical result without an unnecessary provider call or duplicate candidate effect.
